description: Defines the LogNode interface for a logging system that outputs log data to one or multiple targets. It specifies a method for printing log messages with associated metadata such as priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a logging target that can handle and output log data, potentially to multiple destinations, and supports filtering and chaining.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Defines a method for outputting a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable. Intended to be implemented by classes that handle log output.
